name: Kinyarwanda
rows: Abakozi bo ku isi yose nimwunge ubumwe
ibitaro byita ku barwayi bo mu mutwe
Repubulika Iharanira Demokarasi y'Abaturage ya Koreya
gari ya moshi yo munsi y'ubutaka
kujya mu cyiciro gikurikira nta murwanyi
kwica inyoni ebyiri ukoresheje ibuye rimwe
Ubwami Bwunze Ubumwe bwa Bretaniya Nkuru
kuva ku ntangiriro kugeza ku iherezo
